name: Losing Ground
source:
In that pelt factory, surrounded by the relentless grind, your soul is withering. The weight of it all has become too much to carry. You can't bear another moment of this. You need to escape before you lose yourself completely.

[From [url=https://sometotalloser.itch.io/losing-ground]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
在那个毛皮工厂里，周围都是无情的磨砺，你的灵魂正在枯萎。这一切的重量已经变得难以承受。你再也无法忍受这样的时刻了。在你完全迷失自己之前，你需要逃离。

[来自[url=https://sometotalloser.itch.io/losing-ground]Itch.io[/url]]
